# Remastered Modding Field Manual

> Techniques and facts about modding the Command & Conquer Remastered Collection (Steam app 1213210), verified in a
> working mod. Each page is self-contained and laid out the same way: when you need it, the fact or method, how it
> was verified, the game build it holds for, and what is still unproven. Licensed CC BY 4.0. EA has not endorsed and
> does not support this product.

Every page's frontmatter carries `holds_for` (the Steam build it was verified on), `status`, and `unproven` (the
claims not yet tested). Pages that patch the launcher's memory also carry `clientg_sha256`. Before applying any
offset from such a page, check the SHA-256 of the user's `ClientG.exe` against it, and stop if they differ.

## Getting started

- [The mod folder and ccmod.json](getting-started/the-mod-folder-and-ccmod-json.md): a mod is ccmod.json plus a
  Data/ tree; local mods in Documents\CnCRemastered\Mods\Red_Alert (or Tiberian_Dawn); Workshop items need a named
  subfolder; the version is two integers shown as high.low.
- [Building the DLL on Linux](getting-started/building-the-dll-on-linux.md): cross-compile the game DLL with
  32-bit mingw (i686 toolchain, Vanilla Conquer's remaster preset, VC_CXX_FLAGS="-w;-fpermissive"); strip it
  before shipping.
- [Testing under Proton and on the Steam Deck](getting-started/testing-under-proton.md): copy the mod into the
  game's Proton prefix (compatdata/1213210) with rsync -ac --delete, with the game closed; crashes are logged in
  log/CrashLog.txt.
- [Publishing to the Workshop from Linux](getting-started/publishing-to-the-workshop-from-linux.md): a SteamUGC
  uploader using EA's .workshop.json fields; restart Steam first, description at most 8000 characters, upload real
  folders in a named subfolder.

- [HD-only mods](getting-started/hd-only-mods.md): the manual assumes HD graphics mode; switch off the classic
  option with CNCDisableLegacyGraphicsOption in GameConstants_Mod.xml when new art exists only in HD.

## File formats

- [MEG and MIX archives](formats/meg-and-mix-archives.md): MEG = upper-case paths, 20-byte entries sorted by CRC,
  no checksum (EA's Megafile.cs); classic MIX = name-hash index sorted by signed CRC; RA's outer MIX = flags header
  (0x2 encrypted, 0x1 SHA-1 trailer; RA ships 0x0, 0x2 and 0x3), RSA-wrapped Blowfish key, encrypted index.

## Launcher data

- [Overriding the launcher's data](launcher-data/overriding-launcher-data.md): a loose file under Data/ replaces
  its CONFIG.MEG member whole; a replacement CONFIG.MEG must keep every member's exact size; GameConstants_Mod.xml
  merges over GameConstants.xml (overwrite="true" replaces a list). The instance server reads none of them.
- [New text strings](launcher-data/new-text-strings.md): add strings with a loose Data/ModText.csv (UTF-16 LE with
  a BOM; TEXT ID, AUDIO TAG, CHARACTER, then a column per language), merged at load; the MASTERTEXTFILE .LOC table
  can only be relabelled at its exact size.
- [Mod hotkey commands](launcher-data/mod-hotkey-commands.md): CNCEnableModHotKeyGameCommands turns on
  GAME_COMMAND_CNC_MOD_COMMAND_1-4; the DLL gets INPUT_REQUEST_MOD_GAME_COMMAND_n_AT_POSITION with the cell under
  the mouse; players bind the keys, a mod can't ship bindings.

## Front end

- [The UI atlas](front-end/the-ui-atlas.md): launcher 2D UI is regions of MT_COMMANDBAR_COMMON (6871x6716) with an
  .MTD region table; ship a full repainted copy loose, as TGA or DXT5 DDS with mips (padded to 6872 wide); region
  boxes are fixed; per side vs per country.
- [BUI screens](front-end/bui-screens.md): .BUI ChunkFiles ('CH', v2.1, zlib at 0x24, hash unchecked); reshape,
  hide, retint, retexture, clone widgets; FACTIONS.XML GUIFileNames picks the screen. Loose any size.
- [New screens and buttons](front-end/new-screens-and-buttons.md): clone a stock button in a loose RA_MAIN_MENU.BUI
  and bind its click from a hook; a new screen is a loose .BUI on ClientG's unused SplashScreen class, opened with
  GUIManager/Create_Scene_Instance. Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [A faction encyclopedia screen](front-end/faction-encyclopedia.md): a new SplashScreen-class screen listing each
  faction's units with picture, description and live stats; the DLL processes the mod's rules inside ClientG, draws
  pictures into a canvas texture shipped at start-up, and fills a stock list box. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Using what the player already owns

- [TD art from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-art-from-the-base-game.md): draw Tiberian Dawn's HD
  art in a Red Alert mod from the base game's TEXTURES_TD_SRGB.MEG, using opener tiles, instead of shipping copies.
- [TD theatres in Red Alert](using-what-the-player-owns/td-theatres-in-red-alert.md): add TD's desert, temperate
  and winter as Red Alert theatres: launcher slots in GameConstants_Mod.xml, a matching TheaterType and templates
  in the DLL.
- [TD sounds from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-sounds-from-the-base-game.md): play Tiberian
  Dawn's sound effects and EVA lines in a Red Alert mod from the base game's sound MEGs, by naming each sound in the
  DLL and adding RAC_/RAR_ alias events; your own samples must be MS-ADPCM.
- [Content built from the player's own games](using-what-the-player-owns/content-from-the-players-own-games.md):
  EA's guidelines bar music files from any C&C game, so convert Tiberian Sun's soundtrack from the player's own copy
  (MIX/AUD to the Remastered MS-ADPCM WAVs) instead of shipping it. Conversion proven; in-game importer is design
  only.

## Maps and the lobby

- [New maps in the skirmish Official list](maps-and-lobby/new-maps-in-the-skirmish-list.md): list maps with
  INSTANCES.XML and CNCMAPPREVIEWDATA.XML (RA's 128-wide grid); start them under Hastings' D6 entry, whose
  OverrideMapName the DLL honours, by hooking ClientG's launch sends and key lookup. Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [Bigger maps](maps-and-lobby/bigger-maps.md): maps up to 255 cells a side (253x253 playable): widen CELL to
  32 bits with 8-bit X/Y, patch InstanceServerG's two export copies (0x59235A, 0x5982A4) to read bigger arrays,
  re-encode offsets on the launcher's 128-wide grid, skip the legacy render. Byte cell fields cap it at 255.

- [Adding a theatre of your own](maps-and-lobby/custom-theatres.md): slot and DLL steps are proven by TD's
  theatres, but a new terrain template name with loose art crashes the launcher; custom terrain reskins existing
  template names (loose DDS at the stock path). Isometric (TS) conversion is unproven.
- [Custom campaigns: replacing the official ones](maps-and-lobby/custom-campaigns.md): INSTANCES.XML decides what Mission Select shows
  (ShowOnMissionSelect, IsUnlockedAtStart, ExternalGameID), the campaign files what launches; replace a stock
  mission by shipping its scenario (SC<house><nn><dir><var>.INI) in CCDATA/ without [Digest].
- [Per-AI lobby difficulty](maps-and-lobby/per-ai-lobby-difficulty.md): the launcher never sends per-AI skirmish
  difficulty to the DLL; read ClientG's AIPLAYERn records (stride 0xA8: team +0x50, ActLike +0x54, difficulty
  +0x64, colour +0x68) and pick the live copy. Read-only. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Sound and music

- [EVA voice lines the launcher plays](sound-and-music/launcher-eva-lines-by-faction.md): nine EVA voice lines are
  played by ClientG itself; write each faction's recording over the launcher's sample names at match start, and
  over ClientG's cached copy (same-length payloads, whole-file compare before writing). Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [Credit tick and radar sounds by faction](sound-and-music/credit-tick-and-radar-by-faction.md): the launcher
  plays both itself; silence its copy and fire the faction's sound from the DLL under new event names, per house.
- [Music by faction, and the jukebox](sound-and-music/music-by-faction-and-the-jukebox.md): AUDIO_FACTIONS
  MusicMap is unused and the DLL can't play music, so redirect ClientG's skirmish music lookup to a per-faction
  event; jukebox entries are removed only before the jukebox manager's setup. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Engine

- [What the launcher owns: the modding walls](engine/what-the-launcher-owns.md): each behaviour ClientG owns,
  with its route (data, cached-record RAM, launcher code patch) or the evidence it's a real wall. Search data
  first, then the DLL interface, then ClientG memory, then code.
- [Adding a faction](engine/adding-a-faction.md): houses are a fixed enum, so a new side rides one of the
  lobby's eight country rows, either remapped to HOUSE_GOOD/HOUSE_BAD or decoupled from its side mask.
- [LAN games](engine/lan-games.md): only the host runs the simulation and the DLL; PlayerPtr switches per player,
  sounds are addressed per house, DLL keyboard reads see the host only, and every player needs the same mods.
- [Save versions](engine/save-versions.md): SAVEGAME_VERSION is the sum of class sizes and DLLLoad runs before
  the version check, so lead the DLL's save data with your own marker and version.
- [Porting CFE Patch Redux into your DLL](engine/cfe-patch-ports.md): CFE ships its own RedAlert.dll, so port it
  instead; Vanilla Conquer already has some of its fixes; find changes by "Chthon CFE Note" and the INI keys;
  Vanilla Conquer removed EA's SaveLoadPadding, so ported fields change the save version; zoom is data only;
  attack-move needs named missions and reads Shift per player.
- [Letting players change the rules](engine/game-rules.md): a player pass goes after MPLAYER.INI (read only with
  Aftermath units on) and before Fill_In_Data, and again in Load_Game; Read_INI keeps keys a file doesn't name;
  Strength, Sight, ROF and Verses limits; keys leak into the next match.

## Units and buildings

- [Adding a unit](units/adding-a-unit.md): a new UnitType before UNIT_COUNT, a UnitTypeClass constructor
  (geometry offsets only settable there), registration in Init_Heap in exact enum order, a rules.ini section, and a
  classic shape so ImageData isn't null (null = invisible); its frame size sets the selection box.
- [Raising the limits](units/raising-the-limits.md): type heaps sized by enum; live objects and weapon/warhead
  types by rules.ini [Maximums] (ProjectileMax is never used); per-house MaxUnit throttles only the AI; the 75-entry
  sidebar column has a stock off-by-one.
- [Turrets](units/turrets.md): turret frame = body frame + 32 (hull 0-31, turret 32-63); the second draw is limited
  to shapes 0-127 in HD; Fire_Coord offsets; turretless units turn to aim only if tracked, else set is_lock_turret.
- [Units leaving buildings: exits and rails](units/exits-and-rails.md): Exit_Object places a war factory's unit at
  Exit_Coord facing south and drives it out by radio tether; vehicles follow fixed DRIVE.CPP tracks (TrackNumber is
  saved); a new exit path is a per-unit straight-line rail, never a shared static table; sort under the doorway.
- [Porting Tiberian Dawn units](units/porting-td-units.md): Speed = round(MPH x 100 / 256); Tracked= for SPEED_TRACK;
  fill RA-only geometry; ANIM_FRAG2 loads "FRAG3"; TD text IDs don't exist in RA; cloak/scanner is one system.

## AI and pathfinding

- [The skirmish AI and its IQ levels](ai/skirmish-ai-and-iq.md): skirmish runs as GAME_GLYPHX_MULTIPLAYER so campaign
  AI paths are skipped; [IQ] gates each behaviour and every skirmish AI gets MaxIQ; IQ below Production (5) stops base
  building; difficulty is a stat handicap; stock gaps: no skirmish ships, radar only vs air, stubbed urgency checks.
- [Pathfinding](ai/pathfinding.md): stock RA has no A* (EA's edge-following Find_Path); zones ignore buildings;
  allied vehicles head-on are MOVE_NO. Fixes: cfehunter's CFE A* (expansion cap, binary heap, per-cell visited
  table), give-way plus corridor claims, a no-progress give-up.
- [Harvesters](ai/harvesters.md): stock latches and overwritten orders strand harvesters; fixes: a no-progress
  detector, field blacklist, home rescan, watchdog, CFE refinery load-balancing.

## New unit behaviours

- [Gates](behaviours/gates.md): RA has no gates; a gate is a building in a wall line, opened by an ally's request
  before each step (TS Try_Open_Gate), held open while occupied, closed after GateCloseDelay; rebuild zones after.
- [Subterranean units](behaviours/subterranean-units.md): port of TS's tunnel locomotion (OpenTS tunnel.cpp): a
  state machine, a live object moving in a straight line, hidden through the cloak check, legal surfacing cells.
- [Firestorm Defense](behaviours/firestorm-defense.md): a charge-drain superweapon toggled by a patched cameo click;
  live sections kill, block and eat shots; airborne damage doubled because flying aircraft take half; line fill.
- [A stealth generator](behaviours/stealth-generator.md): set IsCloakable and let Cloaking_AI cloak; buildings never
  copy IsCloakable; scanner detection is one-way; hide bibs at draw time.
- [EMP and stun](behaviours/emp-and-stun.md): RA has no timed stun (its Stun() only clears targets); port of OpenTS's
  EMPulseClass: Damage = duration, Spread = radius, stun gates per action.
- [The Tiberium ecosystem](behaviours/tiberium-ecosystem.md): RA ore is LAND_TIBERIUM, so Tiberium needs its own
  overlay; the launcher's IsResource covers only GOLD1-GEMS4; blossom trees; infantry damage; Visceroids.
- [Air delivery, fleets and support powers](behaviours/air-delivery-and-fleets.md): RA has no cargo plane; TD's
  airstrip calls Create_Special_Reinforcement; aircraft need a rules.ini section and non-null ImageData.
- [Jumpjets, deployers, mines and bouncing discs](behaviours/jumpjets-deployers-and-more.md): MissionClass::AI skips
  non-aircraft with Height > 0; deploy where the build-up starts; drone mines as buildings; Distance() runs long.

## Art

- [How the launcher draws sprites](art/how-the-launcher-draws-sprites.md): an HD frame's .meta is a canvas size
  plus a crop box, anchored by canvas centre; second draws use shapes 0-127; no rotation; alpha below ~128
  discarded; ground shadows are baked (black, alpha 191); beam line frames 0-4 only, 3 lines per object.

- [HD tilesets and ZIPs](art/hd-tilesets-and-zips.md): a unit's art is a ZIP of <name>-NNNN.tga + .meta frames,
  one tile per shape in a patched copy of RA_UNITS/RA_STRUCTURES/RA_VFX.XML, a buildables entry named
  RA_<IniName>; TypeName = IniName, AssetName = graphic name.
- [Sprite memory and DDS](art/sprite-memory-and-dds.md): the launcher uploads every enabled mod's textures at
  start-up; ZIP frames cost 4 bytes a pixel of their crop; loose DDS frames about a quarter but need the whole
  canvas, and DXT shifts greys toward team-colour green.
- [Sidebar cameos](art/sidebar-cameos.md): stock cameos are 341x256 BUILDICON_* atlas regions; new ones are loose
  TGA or DDS; the DLL's sidebar AssetName picks the entry, so per-player suffixes swap cameos at runtime.
- [Porting art from other C&C games](art/porting-art-from-other-games.md): Tiberian Sun voxels/SHPs, Red Alert 2 voxels
  and C&C3 models into HD sprites: a 32-degree camera, 32 counter-clockwise facings from north, pure-green team colour,
  a baked shadow.
- [Building selection boxes](art/building-selection-boxes.md): the launcher centres a building's selection box on
  its plot and takes only the size from the DLL; a misplaced box means the art is seated off the plot's centre.

## Structuring a big mod

- [Asset packs](structuring/asset-packs.md): split art and sound into Workshop items the mod depends on; a pack's
  own XMLs never load (the mod carries the merged entries); the DLL detects a pack by a marker file found through
  CNC_Add_Mod_Path; share frames and ZIPs to stay small.
- [A player settings page](structuring/player-settings-page.md): every switch on by default and off meaning
  vanilla's own code path; an INI read once per match; in LAN the host's simulation switches apply to everyone.
- [New units without a DLL of your own](structuring/units-without-a-dll.md): stock RA has no INI route to new
  types; DontCryJustDie's Nuke Tank sample adds one as an add-on to his Veterancy and more DLL.

## Troubleshooting

- [Crash triage](troubleshooting/crash-triage.md): log/CrashLog.txt names the crashing process (ClientG =
  launcher, InstanceServerG = your DLL) and EIP; minidumps give the DLL's base and stack; addr2line on the
  unstripped DLL gives the line; ClientG RVA 0x56A539 is a deliberate assert write, so read the assert text.
- [Known engine traps](troubleshooting/known-engine-traps.md): bugs in EA's released RA source every DLL mod
  inherits: the 512-byte mod search-path buffer overruns at about four mods; RULES/AFTRMATH/MPLAYER.INI resolve the
  current directory first; a sidebar column of 75 writes past its array; the 25-slot NameOverride table fills
  (no dedup, last slot unreachable); a crate that kills its driver.

## Patching the launcher in memory (advanced)

- [Re-pointing launcher UI art in memory](clientg-ram/repointing-atlas-regions.md): give a third faction or
  sub-faction its own radar crest and HUD logos by rewriting ClientG's cached atlas-region records. Fragile:
  verified against one ClientG build only.
- [Patching the launcher's code from your DLL](clientg-ram/patching-the-launchers-code.md): ClientG loads the
  mod's DLL at start-up for CNC_Version; DllMain there can pin the DLL and hook launcher functions on every machine.
  Compare stock bytes before every write. Fragile: one ClientG build only.
- [Rewriting launcher strings in memory](clientg-ram/rewriting-launcher-strings.md): when ClientG builds a name
  in code (the sidebar tab-icon prefixes), rewrite the string in place, never longer, keeping the old tail behind
  the terminator so a patched slot is findable. Fragile: one ClientG build.
